preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The sum of edge weights is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The minimum possible diameter is a non-negative real number not exceeding the sum of edge weights.
The output diameter is correct within an absolute or relative error of 10^-6 compared to the expected diameter.
